title: Amazing workshop
text:
What an amazing workshop! I was genuinely surprised by how spectacular the final result was. This candle looks awesome😍

At first, it seems almost impossible, but by the end, you actually create something beautiful.

The instructors are super fun, friendly, and full of interesting stories. They teach you not only about candles but also about the local culture.

100% recommended! perfect handmade Christmas gift🎄🎁
author: Leila_B

title: Would totally recommend...
text: Would totally recommend it! There were so many decorations and options to choose from, and everyone ended up creating something completely different. The drinks and snacks were a nnice extra. We would definitely do it again!
author: Inma

title: We had such an amazing...
text: We had such an amazing time! The whole experience was really enjoyable, from choosing our favourite scents and decorations to making our own candles from scratch. The staff were super friendly and helpful, and we left with beautiful handmade souvenirs. Definitely recommend it!
author: David

title: I will definitely repeat
text: A super fun experience, it really looks like you can eat the candles, I don't even plan on lighting it because of how pretty it turned out.
author: Andrea_L
